title: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
provenance: Reported by ponglerdluk (highball-db#287, 2026-10-02), Apple M5 in a MacBook Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.39, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r11, Apple's DirectX 12 support (D3DMetal) as the environment's mode, rated 5 of 5 once set up, session length not stated, recipes steam, vcrun2022, fakejapanese, corefonts. Not verified by the maintainer. anmlul (highball-db#1277, 2026-11-16), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.3, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 5 of 5 after 143 minutes: AVX advertised, a 120 fps cap, the concrt140-native recipe (concrt140=n,b) and the fakejapanese, corefonts, controller-sdl, dotnet48, xact and physx recipes. jaykup2 (highball-db#1460, 2026-11-25), Apple A18 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal by the report (the environment's mode is DXVK), rated 4 of 5 after 11 minutes: with the steam and vcrun2022 recipes and the tomb-raider-iv-vi-remastered recipe from another game. Periodic pauses in play, most of all when about to crash, in the player's words, or when the view changes. Windowed mode with no other programs running made them less frequent.
notes: Reported perfect on D3DMetal on the default engine once two things are set: the game's DirectX 11 build is started with -d3d11 (Steam offers 'Play Tokyo Xtreme Racer (DirectX 11)' at launch, and the reporter put -d3d11 in Steam's launch options), and the environment's graphics mode is Apple's DirectX 12 support. In-game settings all Medium with TSR anti-aliasing, which the reporter says keeps the MacBook Pro cool and the game playable. The row passes -d3d11 to the game on Play so the Steam launch option is not needed. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here, so whether the game also runs on DXMT with -d3d11, or on D3DMetal without it, is not known. Rated perfect again over 143 minutes on an M5 Pro on the default engine (r28), D3DMetal by the report, with AVX advertised and the native concrt140 recipe (highball-db#1277). On an A18 Pro MacBook it was rated playable over 11 minutes on the default engine r28, D3DMetal by the report, with periodic pauses that windowed mode eased (highball-db#1460).

knownIssues.symptom: Periodic pauses in play, most of all when about to crash or when the view changes (A18 Pro, D3DMetal by the report, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#1460)
knownIssues.fix: run the game in windowed mode with no other programs open, which made the pauses less frequent for the reporter
